query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS suspicious_activities (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  ip_address VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL,
  activity_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL COMMENT 'hotlink_attempt, bot_detected, high_activity, etc.',
  details TEXT COMMENT 'Detalles adicionales del incidente',
  suspicion_score INT DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Score de 0-100',
  detected_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX idx_ip_address (ip_address),
  INDEX idx_detected_at (detected_at),
  INDEX idx_suspicion_score (suspicion_score)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Tracking de actividades sospechosas para anti-scraping';
